comment: Single source of truth for the private-source provenance screen. The pattern is DERIVED as alternations.join('|') by scripts/private_source_screen.py (ASCII case-insensitive) and by site/src/__tests__/forecast-catalog.test.ts (flag i), so both engines fold case identically over the ASCII tokens below. The converter refuses agent-authored hits and withholds reviewer-authored preSubmitReview text behind the marker in every projection (spawned cells, live/strategy comparisons, the Brier-judge prompt); the catalog test is the fail-closed backstop. Canaries are behavioral: every probe is asserted at python import and in the site suite, and each alternation must be the SOLE match for at least one probe, so a weakened or deleted branch fails even if its literal remains. chat-transcript is intentionally absent: \btranscripts?\b subsumes it. This file is review-gated; a coordinated edit of a branch plus its probes is a reviewed change by construction.
